title: Uttar Pradesh’s Rich Heritage and Modern Milestones on Display at the Prime Minister Mementos e-Auction 2026
subtitle: Spiritual landmarks, traditional art, sporting achievements and modern infrastructure come together to showcase the diverse identity of Uttar Pradesh
body_text:
A diverse collection of 99 mementos offers a glimpse into Uttar Pradesh’s cultural heritage, historical legacy and contemporary achievements. Featuring spiritual artefacts, traditional art, sporting memorabilia and models of major infrastructure projects. The 8th edition of the PM Mementos e-Auction is live online till October 2, 2026. For details and participation, visit https://pmmementos.gov.in
Among the prominent mementos featured is a detailed model of the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya, crafted in MDF fibreboard with intricate architectural detailing.
Another memento features the Shri Guru Ravidas Janam Asthan Mandir in Varanasi, highlighting the spiritual and cultural legacy associated with Guru Ravidas.
A framed portrait of Rani Lakshmi Bai depicts the Queen of Jhansi on horseback with her son Damodar Rao, while a contemporary Sanjhi paper-cut artwork from Mathura presents a "Tree of Life with Holy Cows”. The Sanjhi piece also showcases the intricate hand-cutting technique associated with the traditional art form.
Uttar Pradesh’s sporting achievements are represented by a signed shirt belonging to para-athlete Preeti Pal, who won two bronze medals in the 100m and 200m T35 events at the 2024 Paris Paralympics.
The catalogue also features a miniature model of the Meerut Metro, commemorating the inauguration of its 26-km corridor in February 2026.
Other notable entries include a Namo Ghat Varanasi hand namaste memento, a sculptural representation of the distinctive joined hands at Namo Ghat and a Ganga Expressway model featuring Goddess Ganga alongside a miniature representation of the infrastructure project.
Together, these mementos bring different facets of Uttar Pradesh into focus, from its traditions and history to its achievements and landmarks.
